title: Architectural Ablation Switch Matrix (RFC004 §52.1)
$comment: Closed contract: RFC004 §52.1's eleven mandatory ablation switches, independently configurable at a fixed output contract. RFC004 does not name required runs, thresholds or a statistical protocol (§52); this schema only proves the switches exist and are comparable. A switch whose experimental variant has no implementation yet is declared status='not_available' rather than omitted, so the closed switch_id enum never silently shrinks to 'whatever happens to be built'.

comparison_invariants.$comment: RFC004 §52.2: none of these may change within one ablation comparison, or the result is not an isolated architecture ablation.

status.$comment: 'available': both variants are independently configurable in this codebase today. 'control_only': the control variant exists but the experimental one is not built yet. 'not_available': neither variant is independently configurable yet -- declared, never omitted.
